verdict.rationale: Logseq has plugin API documentation at plugins-doc.logseq.com, though it describes itself as community-driven. Developers can load their own plugins via 'Load unpacked plugin' and distribute them through the Marketplace, and the local HTTP server exposes the same documented methods. The evidence never shows sample plugins, a named SDK package or starter templates, and the API reference is community-maintained rather than first-party. Missing for 10: sample/template plugins, an explicitly documented SDK package, first-party in-depth developer guides, hands-on corroboration of building a plugin.
